results.title: Pin de Fartie
results.overview: Pin de Fartie unfolds as a playful spin on theatrical adaptation and an experiment in character dynamics. The film charts three relationships defined by Samuel Beckett’s 1957 play Fin de Partie (Endgame): one between a blind man and his daughter; another concerning two actors rehearsing that same text; the third following a man who reads his blind mother Beckett’s play and discovers that it reflects their lives.

results.title: I'll Play Mother
results.overview: After the death of their birth mother, two young children are placed in the care of prospective adopter parents, however, it's not long before the new family begin to question if something more sinister is at play.

results.title: Joelma – Uma Noite Amazônica: Ao Vivo em Portugal
results.original_title: Joelma – Uma Noite Amazônica: Ao Vivo em Portugal
results.overview: Get ready for a vibrant and exciting celebration of Amazonian culture with "Uma Noite Amazônica – Ao Vivo em Portugal," Joelma's first international solo DVD. Recorded at the iconic Coliseu dos Recreios in Lisbon on September 13, 2024, the show combines energy, Brazilian flair, and visual spectacle at every turn.

results.title: Between Shared Wall
results.overview: Pau, a young man with little commitment to work, has long been putting off recovering the emotional relationship he once lost with his father Plàcid, an old and affable farmer. The recent death of Pau's mother and the lack of qualified personnel in the fields will lead Pau to think more carefully about his next move.

results.title: Nemesis
results.overview: A man recounts to his therapist four instances of being stalked by a masked killer who hasn't been seen in ten years.

results.title: Out of Order
results.overview: A lawyer trying to turn his life around, finds himself in double jeopardy when he takes on a big new case - representing both sides.

results.title: The Slasher Nurse
results.overview: After a prank goes wrong, one person is left dead and another institutionalized. Ten years later, a group of friends are partying at a cabin in the woods unaware that a deranged psychiatric patient has escaped and is hell bent on revenge.

results.title: Witchy Ways
results.overview: When a skeptical woman retreats to a secluded cabin believed to be magical, she falls for its enigmatic witch owner, until dark spells, buried secrets, and a restless ghost threaten their chance at love.

results.title: Ofélia
results.overview: Amid dynamics of power, desire, and seduction, Ofélia follows two teenagers who discover their mutual attraction on the threshold between adolescence and adulthood, while simultaneously seeking to define their identity and place within an everchanging society.

results.title: WWE/AAA Worlds Collide 2025: Las Vegas
results.overview: Worlds Collide was a 2025 professional wrestling livestreaming event and supercard co-produced by the American promotion WWE and its Mexican sister promotion AAA. It was the fifth Worlds Collide under the WWE banner and the second between both promotions. It took place on September 12, 2025, at the Cox Pavilion at the Thomas & Mack Center in the Las Vegas suburb of Paradise, Nevada. It marked the first time WWE has held two Worlds Collide events in the same year, following the June 2025 event.

results.title: The Reckoning
results.overview: An American man’s will stipulates his ashes be spread at a French chateau he visited years previous. Caught off guard, his disabled widow and two sons are forced overseas to fulfill the strange request. Haunted by his dead father once there, the eldest son unearths a dark family secret that leads to a horrifying outcome.

results.title: Delulu
results.overview: The short film follows Natalie as she spirals through a romanticised view of relationships and an inability to cut off the toxic ones. Using stylised cinematography and shifting perspectives, including VHS footage with a friend behind the camera, the film reveals her delusional inner world. The film is aimed at those who seek subtle stories that resonate with their personal experiences and offer reflections on relationships with themselves and others.

results.title: Teagan and His Bros
results.overview: Teagan and His Bros is a show about two lovable stoners that adopt a cat who's...also a stoner. In this four episode "first season," Connor and Bobby learn what it truly means to own and love a cat with the help of their Muppet-esque talking feline Teagan.

results.title: A Stolen Life
results.overview: In 2002, a serial murder case occurred in the seaside town of Dening. Gambler Sun Xingwang was killed, followed by Zhu Zhihong, deputy director of Donghu Market, and his brother Zhou Liang. The three murders were committed in the same way. Various suspicious evidence pointed to Jiang Siming, the sworn brother of Zhu Zhihong and Zhou Liang. When the police were closing in on Jiang Siming, he was attacked and hunted down. In a critical moment, the police took action and captured the real murderer. They thought the case could be closed, but the inside story was just revealed, and the fate storm of Jiang Siming and his wife Wu Yan swept in... In the seaside town of Fujian filled with incense, the murderer by the pillow, the lover in the crowd, and the fateful life waiting for redemption are hidden in the market.

results.title: Schadenfreude
results.overview: Jeremy O'Reilly, the self-important presenter of a TV news show, returns to a clueless East End community where a prank leads to the murder of a beautiful local actress and a savage Press that demands to know, "Who killed Paige Boston?"

results.title: La mitad de Ana
results.overview: Son confesses to his mother, Ana, that he does not feel like a girl; he is a boy. Confused and blocked, Ana will decide to stop in order to observe and understand him and, in the same way, to understand herself. Ana and Son are two sides of the same coin: a mother who does not take care of herself, of her own identity, and a boy in search of his identity with all his strength.
